verdict.rationale: NotebookLM's documented capabilities are grounded chat, source summarization, and single-pass format transformations (study guides, audio overviews, mind maps) over sources the user supplies — none of this evidences autonomous, multi-step research planning or iterative investigation. A community report even states the tool cannot autonomously search for and incorporate new documents into research, reinforcing that it stays within a single-pass, source-bound model rather than conducting agentic multi-step investigations.
